results.title: [Research Ready] Keep Calm and Read Laterally!
results.description:
It is easy to go down the rabbit hole of online information when it first hits you. Instead of going deep, let’s go lateral. Learn about lateral reading strategies and media literacy tips, flex your fact-checking muscles and effectively engage with digital information.

(Complete any 3 workshops in the Research Ready Series to earn a digital badge for your LinkedIn profile!)

Note: You are welcome to walk in even if you've missed the registration window of this workshop. Please bring along your laptop or tablet with Internet access.

What did our previous participants say about this workshop?

  • "The concept itself of lateral reading was very helpful."
  • "It was an interesting and eye opening perspective on literacy skills. The hands-on activity was very useful to see how it is applied."
  • "Good to know a new method to evaluate sources and some fact-checking websites."
  • "The information given was so useful to apply in daily study."
